sangre: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: a medical illustration plate to be placed as ten separate figures in a Spanish premedical study PDF about BLOOD. Create ONE tall image, aspect ratio 2:5, organized as EXACTLY TWO EQUAL COLUMNS and FIVE EQUAL ROWS, TEN square white panels, no gutters, no borders. Each drawing fits in the central 80% of its own square with ample WHITE background. Refined medically accurate textbook illustration, delicate outlines, realistic shaded structures, burgundy red, blue and warm neutral palette. NO WORDS, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARKS. Reading order row by row: 1 cutaway of blood vessel with biconcave red cells, one nucleated white cell, tiny platelets suspended in straw plasma; 2 upright blood sample centrifuge tube with yellow plasma upper 55%, extremely thin white buffy coat, red erythrocytes bottom45%; 3 close up biconcave erythrocytes with a small conceptual hemoglobin tetramer inset; 4 cutaway spongy bone with red marrow and developing red cells emerging, a small kidney icon nearby; 5 spleen with erythrocyte recycling as a simple unlabelled circular arrow sequence, liver nearby; 6 isolated five leukocyte types, neutrophil segmented nucleus, eosinophil bilobed red granules, basophil dark granules, monocyte kidney nucleus, lymphocyte large round nucleus; 7 magnified leukocyte squeezing between two endothelial cells toward bacteria; 8 platelet adhesion at a damaged vessel wall and delicate fibrin mesh trapping red cells; 9 branching cascade represented by three successive molecules ending in fibrin fibers and a small dissolving clot; 10 four separate red cell membrane examples with different tiny A and B surface antigen shapes and corresponding antibody shapes, educational ABO concept, no transfusion arrows and no labels. Exact 2x5 grid is essential for clipping these ten panels into ten PDF pages. Clean professional original art, never photomicrograph or collage with text.
sentidos: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: ten original medical illustrations for a Spanish premedical summary about SENSORY ORGANS. Create ONE tall image, aspect ratio 2:5, EXACTLY TWO EQUAL COLUMNS by FIVE EQUAL ROWS of ten square panels, white backgrounds, no gutters or borders. Drawings contained within central 80% of each square so each panel can be clipped independently to one PDF page. Professional anatomically accurate textbook illustrations, delicate linework, realistic dimensional shading, navy, teal, skin tones, warm coral; crisp clean white background. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARK. Row-by-row panel content: 1 sensory receptor ending connected to a single myelinated afferent neuron, stimulus becomes signal indicated with small directional arrows; 2 skin cutaway featuring superficial Meissner corpuscle and deeper onionlike Pacinian corpuscle, plus small muscle spindle beside it; 3 simple conceptual pain pathway showing fingertip stimulus, peripheral afferent into spinal cord dorsal horn, ascending route toward brain, include a separate descending arrow; 4 tongue with papilla and an enlarged taste bud inset with receptor cells converging to sensory nerve, taste pore apical and nerve basal; 5 sagittal nasal cavity showing superior olfactory epithelium, fibers crossing cribriform plate to olfactory bulb above; 6 clear sagittal ear cutaway showing external canal, tympanic membrane, three ossicles, oval window, cochlea and semicircular canals; 7 uncoiled conceptual basilar membrane with organ of Corti inset, hair-cell stereocilia near tectorial membrane; 8 vestibular labyrinth with three semicircular canals and small separate macula inset showing hair cells with otoliths in gelatinous layer; 9 sagittal eyeball, cornea anterior, lens behind iris, vitreous, retina posterior, optic nerve leaving posterior eye, light rays focused on retina; 10 simple retinal layer schematic with rods and cones, bipolar cells, ganglion cells and optic nerve, arrows indicating light direction versus neural signal direction, no written labels. Keep exact ten-panel grid, generous padding in every panel, elegant real medical educational drawings rather than icons or cartoon.
